Now my favourite part: how this website was made. As we scroll, glowing lines grow out of the core and reveal each piece.

Live 3D sky. The sky behind this page isn't a picture. It's a real 3D scene with drifting clouds and a glowing sun, drawn live in your browser. Move your mouse and the whole sky shifts with you, smooth at 60 frames per second.

Zoom-through scroll. Scrolling here doesn't slide a page, it flies you forward. Each section zooms past like a cloud while the next one rushes in and settles gently into place, so moving through the site feels like a journey.

Glass interface. Every card and button is frosted glass floating over the sky. Panels tilt toward your cursor and catch the light, so the whole interface feels soft, layered and alive instead of flat.

A living guide. The girl giving you this tour is a rigged 3D model, animated in Blender. She flies in when you press AI Auto, presents every section, points at what she talks about, and her hair and coat move with real spring physics.
No build step. The whole site is plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript with no build step and no setup. It opens straight away, works anywhere, and stays easy for me to keep improving.
Every screen size. Phone, tablet or a big desktop, the same story plays on all of them. The layout reshapes itself to fit, and if you prefer less motion, the site calms down and respects that too.
